scientific_integrity: A self-contained algebraic proof supports all graph sizes; two independent finite checkers are supplied with actual outputs. Published claims are compared by mathematical implication; no independent audit is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem covers only parity-neighbor updates over F2 on complete bipartite graphs with one visit per vertex in a repeatedly fixed scan. Novelty relative to unindexed historical equivalences is not guaranteed; one closest synchronous record was accessible only by summary. Verification enumerations are finite and do not replace the proof.
title: A modulo-three scheduling law for sequential parity dynamics on complete bipartite graphs
